enquete.name: Les romans policiers · Detective stories
enquete.alt: The museum's detective-story gallery on its 'solve the mystery' family day, seen from the near left: bottle-green walls, brass picture lamps, red velvet ropes on brass posts and a giant deerstalker hat over the striped puppet booth. At the back left a cheerful lady in a black dress holds up a blue prize rosette behind the iron bars of the old prison-cell exhibit while her friend photographs her; at a café table two old ladies frown comically and tug the one teacup. In the middle Monsieur Verbe in a red beret plays the fairy-tale witch in the puppet booth, dipping a red apple into a bubbling green cauldron beside a hobby-horse pony and a girl in a witch hat. At the back right a waxwork gentleman-criminal in a top hat and mask holds a popsicle and a little bell, and a waxwork villain in a cloak stands empty-handed in a tall glass case with sand at his boots. In front a young woman in a red cape raises a lantern and magnifying glass, a giant striped party popper bursts confetti as a girl in yellow claps, a girl offers a cookie to a little white dog guarding a small white model of the Taj Mahal, and a detective in a deerstalker studies a red jewel cushion smeared with whipped cream. On the right a man in a Hawaiian shirt rushes the gift-shop postcard racks, a grinning masked burglar tiptoes off with a small painting and a fishing rod with a green lure, and a man in a bow tie clutches his hot cheeks beside a flame-red book on a lectern. Doors: slate-blue on the left back to the great hall, iron-studded oak at the back, plain gray at the back right.

armes.name: La salle d'armes · The armory hall
armes.alt: The museum's armory hall, seen from the near left: gray stone walls, iron chandeliers with white bulbs, a blue banner with a smiling golden lion and one unbroken red velvet rope on brass posts running in front of the displays; every weapon is an antique display object and nobody holds one. On the far left a life-size figure of Sir Lancelot in a blue tunic with a white cross stands on a stone plinth beside his tall striped jousting lance. On the back wall a big bronze arm sticks out of the stone, holding up an old mace, while a little girl points up at it; a ginger cat mews at the feet of an empty suit of armor, and a forester lady holds an ash sprig up to an old ax on a wall rack. In front a lady offers a candy from a paper bag beside a small glass case with a round black cartoon bomb, its fuse unlit, and a gray-haired lady hands a coin to a guard beside a long shining sword lying on a red velvet cushion. On the right an old gentleman points a yardstick at a jeweled dagger on a cushion, a guard dozes on a stool below an old rifle on wall pegs, a man in a green cardigan makes a peace sign by the small pistol case, a boy holds up a toy Noah's ark toward the longbow on the wall, and a potter holds up a little clay shield beside a big round painted shield. Door: bottle-green on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery.

mots_delits.name: Le couloir des mots (1) · Word corridor 1 (text only)
mots_delits.alt: A quiet, plain word corridor of the museum seen straight down its length: pale gray walls, pale oak floor and three round milk-glass lamps. Small blank cream plaques with brass screws hang at different heights along both walls, five on the left and eight on the right; two low wooden lecterns in the middle each hold one more blank plaque. Nothing is depicted: the words here exist only as wall text. A potted fern stands on a bench against the back wall. Doors: plain gray on the left wall, back to the detective-story gallery; plain gray at the back, on to the second word corridor.
